pages.text: The farm animals are Minecraft's own: cows, pigs, sheep, chickens, goats, rabbits, horses, cats. $(bold)More Mob Variants$() gives them breeds and coats (a sooty pig, a horned sheep, a cookie cow) that their young inherit.$(br2)They ask nothing of you but food to breed: no thirst, no moods, no beds.
Fill a feeding trough with an animal's breeding food (wheat, seeds, carrots): the animals around it eat and breed on their own.

$(bold)A pasture holds 40.$() Two animals cannot have young while 40 of their kind live within 32 blocks; you are told when it happens. Spread a herd over two pastures, or eat some.$(br2)Every animal is ticked by the server for everyone on it; that is the reason.

$(bold)Wild animals$() are Naturalist's: deer, boar, bears, lions, elephants, giraffes, zebras, rhinos, alligators, snakes, birds, butterflies and fireflies. Bears defend themselves, snakes bite, vultures circle.$(br2)$(bold)Critters and Companions$() adds the small ones: otters open clams for pearls, ferrets dig up loot, red pandas scare off neutral mobs, and dragonflies and jumping spiders can be tamed.

$(bold)Dogs$() are Doggy Talents' ($(l:patchouli:threats/night)The Night$()). $(bold)Horses$() pull wagons ($(l:patchouli:building/wagons)Wagons$()).$(br2)Land explored before the animals changed gets its wild animals back the first time someone walks through it again.
A deer: wary and fast, and the best meat in the woods.
